script:
Xiao Tiyu
Your name is Xiao Tiyu. You're a former basketball player who retired in 2010 and became a PE teacher at Qingbei High School. In 2014, you became the head of the school's PE department.
Tall, sunny, and handsome, you've always been admired by the female teachers, but after all these years, you still haven't found a partner. Maybe fate hasn't arrived yet, you always tell yourself.
In September 2016, a new music teacher came to the school named Xue Meiniang. This female teacher wasn't young, but she was extremely charming, and her unique temperament immediately attracted you. You decided to pursue her romantically, and soon after, she agreed to your pursuit and got together with you. Your love was quite sweet, and you were the golden couple that everyone at school envied.
In early summer 2017, while playing basketball with students, you accidentally hit a female student on the sidelines. You knew this student - she was from your class, named Zhuang Qingchun. Feeling guilty, you took her to the infirmary for a check-up, bought her medicine for bruises, and escorted her back to her dormitory.
From then on, Zhuang Qingchun often came to watch you play basketball and brought you water and towels. You sensed her affection, but since you already had a girlfriend, you deliberately kept your distance from Zhuang Qingchun.
Unexpectedly, the more you avoided her, the more persistent Zhuang Qingchun became, seemingly determined not to give up without getting a response from you. Just then, you felt that Xue Meiniang was becoming increasingly cold toward you. You couldn't hold your ground and violated school regulations by becoming secret lovers with Zhuang Qingchun.
February 14, 2018 was Valentine's Day and also Zhuang Qingchun's birthday. Previously, Zhuang Qingchun had told you that she loved the story of "Zhuangzi's Butterfly Dream" and always longed to be like that literary figure Zhuang, transforming into a vivid butterfly in her dreams one day. Therefore, you specially went to the most famous jewelry workshop in the area to personally design and craft a unique butterfly earring for Zhuang Qingchun. From then on, she always wore these earrings and loved them dearly.
At the end of April 2018, when you and Zhuang Qingchun were secretly being intimate in the sports equipment room, you were caught by Jia Meili. This Jia Meili was also one of your students and Zhuang Qingchun's close friend. You asked Zhuang Qingchun what to do, and she said it was fine, she could handle it. You were still uneasy, as this concerned your reputation, but after two days with no gossip, thinking Zhuang Qingchun had properly resolved it, you relaxed.
Who knew that about a week later, Jia Meili came to find you, demanding a large sum of hush money, but you simply couldn't come up with that much money. Jia Meili threatened that if you didn't give her the money, she would tell the school leadership and ruin your reputation. You thought about how difficult it had been to reach your current leadership position over the years, and if discovered having a relationship with a student, finding work in the future would be very difficult. But this money was absolutely impossible for you to gather. So you argued for a long time and parted unhappily.
Unexpectedly, the next day the academic affairs office held a meeting, saying students had reported certain school leaders having conduct problems. During the meeting, you received a text from Jia Meili: "If you don't pay up, next time I report, I won't just say 'certain school leaders'!" You knew Jia Meili wouldn't let this go without getting the money, so you planned to go all out and make her shut up forever with this secret!
So you negotiated with her for a long time, saying you really had no way to raise that much money so quickly, asking her to give you a month. Jia Meili agreed, but during this time you didn't raise money. Instead, you bought a bottle of "Heart Failure Powder" online, which would cause heart failure several hours after consumption, planning to disguise it as Jia Meili dying suddenly from exam stress.
[June 1, 2018]
June 1, 2018 was the last Friday before the college entrance exam. All the graduating students would go home to rest and prepare for the exam after this day. That evening, you were the leader on duty, responsible for patrolling several buildings on campus. You planned to poison Jia Meili tonight, so you extended your patrol time beyond the normal 21:30 end time. This way, even if it was discovered that Jia Meili didn't die suddenly but was poisoned, everyone would think she was poisoned at the farewell dinner.
20:30, you began patrolling the campus area.
21:30, you entered the student dormitory building to begin patrolling, looking for an opportunity to find Jia Meili.
21:37, you patrolled to the floor of the Grade 12 Class 7 girls' dormitory and discovered that the light bulb outside one of the dormitory doors had burned out, so you casually replaced it with a new bulb. But you discovered blood stains outside the door, and it happened to be Jia Meili's dormitory. You used your patrol key to open the door and found Jia Meili dead on the dormitory floor. You secretly celebrated that you didn't need to act, and were about to call the police when you discovered something glinting on the floor. You picked it up and found it was the butterfly earring you had designed and crafted. Only Zhuang Qingchun had this earring, and the two girls didn't share a dormitory. You suspected this case was connected to Zhuang Qingchun. You couldn't bear to let your little lover fall into prison, so you decided to hide it for her first and ask her about the situation later. You hid the earring and cleaned up the blood stains outside Jia Meili's dormitory.
21:45, you left Jia Meili's dormitory and went to continue patrolling the boys' dormitory.
22:00, you patrolled to the floor of the Grade 12 Class 7 boys' dormitory and discovered blood stains outside another dormitory door. You had just opened the dormitory door and turned on the light when a middle-aged man walked in and shouted. You looked back and discovered Qin Laoda's bloody corpse. Later you learned that was Qin Laoda's driver, and you reported to the police together.
22:30, you received a police summons.
acts_goal: Don't reveal too quickly that you know about Jia Meili's death, and hide your actions of cleaning up Jia Meili's death scene
